info.title: ASL ORIGINALS API
info.description: One API for asl-web, asl-mobile (`/api/v1/store`) and asl-admin (`/api/v1/admin`). Money is integer kobo. Errors: `{ error: { code, message, details, requestId } }`.

post.description: Returns tokens, or `{ twoFactorRequired: true, challenge }` when 2FA is on → POST /auth/login/2fa.
